title: afrormosia angolensis
intro: Afrormosia angolensis, commonly known as African pear or Kambala, is a tropical tree species belonging to the family Lauraceae. The health benefits of Afrormosia angolensis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an analgesic, antiseptic, and expectorant, making it effective in treating conditions like arthritis, wounds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Afrormosia angolensis include flavonoids, terpenes, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
